tuccha.p: [Tuca+cha] (ti) CL=7 [Dhāna, ṭī. 698. Tuda+cha. Tudanaṃ tucchā. Kaccaññaḥ. 638. Nīti, sutta. 1250. Tuda byathane, tucchā. Rū. 660. Tusa+cha. Ṇvādi. 44. Dhātvattha. 169.] (1) Useless, (A) Free from. (B) Cessation. (C) Without gain. (D) Without essence. (E) Nothing (such as the sky). (2) It is changing for the worse. (3) A little. (4) Inferior. (Thi) (5) piercing and lacerating.
